corpus.title: Synthetic motion, thin geometry, occlusion, and HUD fixture
corpus.source: Project-authored analytic scene; no third-party footage or assets.
corpus.mask_overlap_policy: Masks are evaluated independently and may overlap; HUD/text and scene/occlusion are not forced into a partition.

configuration.runner_mode: offline serial submit, completion wait, and readback

metric_parameters.perceptual_metric: project-authored masked multiscale luminance SSIM plus CIE76 color score
metric_parameters.temporal_time_unit: actual elapsed high-rate frame periods from timestamps
metric_parameters.source_with_generation_throughput_method: two source-frame texture uploads plus serial submit-to-completion per cycle, divided by measured wall time from before uploads through completion; offline benchmark host only; excludes renderer work and presentation

performance.dropped_generated_frames_method: count of measured serial generation completions above deadline; not observed presentation drops
performance.source_frame_fps_impact_method: 100 * (source_only_input_fps - source_with_generation_input_fps) / source_only_input_fps; two source-frame texture uploads plus serial submit-to-completion per cycle, divided by measured wall time from before uploads through completion; offline benchmark host only; excludes renderer work and presentation
performance.source_frame_fps_impact_scope: offline input-throughput proxy only; excludes renderer work, game FPS, and presentation
